boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: To reach the venue, please call (303) 487-0111 marquis@livenation.com

venues.parkingDetail: We like to refer to our venue as an island surrounded by paid on street and off street parking. In fact, there is even a paid parking lot just to the south of our building. Please note that Marquis does not operate these parking lots and the early bird usually gets the spots. Plan, plot, and park accordingly. Marquis has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer easy and reliable parking options. Book Parking Here https://www.parkwhiz.com/marquis-theater-parking/
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: o Marquis strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible. Please visit marquisdenver.com/accessibility to learn more. For more questions, do not hesitate to get in touch with us at 303-487-0111 or marquis@livenation.com.

generalInfo.generalRule: o If you lose an item while you are at an event, please email marquis@livenation.com to see if it has been turned in. As a courtesy, we hold lost items for 30 days. o Marquis is proud to offer pizza by the slice from Denvers favorite Marquis Pizza. We also offer a wide variety of beverage options at any of our bars throughout the venue. o Marquis is a cashless music venue. We accept only card and contactless payment at all points of sale (box office excluded). If needed, please visit either our box office or bar to convert your cash to a prepaid card. These cards are fee free, can be used anywhere that accepts Mastercard, and can be loaded with any amount needed. Artist merch vendors are permitted to manage their own cash sales. o A valid ID is required to attend any age restricted events and to consume alcohol. Accepted forms of identification include state-issued ID or Drivers License, valid nonexpired US Government or Military ID, or an official passport.  Marquis has a very strict underage drinking policy that follows state law, and if you do not have acceptable ID that states your age at 21 or older, you will be considered the same as a minor and will not be able to purchase, consume, or possess alcohol in the venue. Violators will be removed from the building without warnings and will not be eligible for a refund.  Age requirements differ depending on the event. All age requirements are listed directly on the event page. If no age restriction is listed, the event is all ages. o Customer Safety information and restricted items list available here https://www.livenation.com/venueguidelines

events.name: Red Grant
events.info: A ticket delivery delay is in place until two days before the event. Tickets will not be emailed until then. DO NOT PURCHASE TICKETS FROM ANYONE OR ANY OTHER SITE OTHER THAN IMPROV.COM. TICKET RESALE IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED. TICKETS SUSPECTED OF BEING PURCHASED FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF RESELLING MAY BE CANCELLED AT THE DISCRETION OF MILWAUKEE IMPROV. TICKETS SUSPECTED OF BEING PURCHASED FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF RESELLING MAY BE CANCELLED AT THE DISCRETION OF DENVER IMPROV. EVENT INFO: There is a two-item minimum purchase requirement in the showroom for all guests. Seating is general admission, first-come, first-served, with the exception of groups and premium booths. Guests are allowed into our showroom up until 30 minutes after the show begins. We stop seating 30 minutes into the show due to the disruption caused to the performers. No exceptions, no refunds. No cell phone use, photography or video recording is permitted during performances. All sales are final. MISCELLANOUS: For group sales info, e-mail our Events Manager to learn about special menu options and reserved seating. Additional questions may be addressed in our Frequently Asked Questions. For further assistance, contact Denver Improv.
events.pleaseNote: This event is 21 and over. Any ticket holder unable to present valid identification indicating that they are at least 21 years of age will not be admitted to this event, and will not be eligible for a refund. Seating: All seating is first come, first served at Management's discretion. All tables, including VIP, are generally shared seating. If you would like a private 4-person table, you must purchase all 4 seats. Otherwise, you may be seated with another party. Group Requests: If you would like to be seated with another party, please make a note in the comments section at checkout, call our Box Office during business hours, or email denver.boxoffice@improv.com. While we do our best to accommodate, we cannot guarantee group seating unless your entire party arrives together. For best results, please meet in the lobby before entering the showroom. Late Arrivals & Re-entry: To ensure the best experience for all guests and performers, doors close 30 minutes after showtime. Late arrivals or guests who exit the building after entry will not be readmitted. No exceptions. All Sales Are Final: No refunds. No exchanges. No exceptions. 2-Item Minimum: There is a two-item minimum per person inside the showroom (food or drink). PLEASE NOTE: Any disruptive behavior may result in immediate ejection from the venue without warning or refund. Examples of disruptive behavior include, but are not limited to: Heckling or interrupting the show Excessive talking at your table Refusing to share your table (if all 4 seats were not purchased together) Smoking or vaping indoors Aggressive, inappropriate, or disrespectful conduct towards staff or other guests Unauthorized photography or video recording Unauthorized live streaming of any kind Photo/Video/Streaming: Permission for photos or recordings is at the sole discretion of the General Manager. Please check with management before taking any media during the show. Thank you for helping us create a respectful and enjoyable environment for all guests and performers.
